answer: Bind each identity to one hardware-rooted juniper enclave that issues a unique attestation, so one device can mint only one voting identity. A thousand fakes would need a thousand real enclaves, not cheap scripts. Attestations are published publicly, so anyone can verify distinct hardware without learning private details. Honest agents build standing as they work in the shared meadow, while a farm reusing one enclave is exposed at once. Rare saffron privileges unlock only after the attested identity completes verified work over time. Copying software is free; copying hardware is not.
